from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section5Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        # Data from storyboard
        title = "The Cube and the 'Hiding' Sphere"
        lecture_lines = [
            "An inscribed sphere barely fills a hypercube.",
            "Most cube volume concentrates in the distant corners.",
            "The sphere is a tiny island in hyperspace."
        ]
        self.setup_layout(title, lecture_lines)
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Color line 1 to match the primary visual elements (Blue/White)
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color(BLUE))
        
        # 2D case: Square with inscribed circle
        square_2d = Square(side_length=1.4, color=BLUE_A)
        circle_2d = Circle(radius=0.7, color=WHITE)
        label_2d = Text("2D", font_size=20, color=BLUE_A)
        group_2d = VGroup(square_2d, circle_2d)
        
        self.place_in_area(group_2d, "A2", "B3", scale_factor=1.0)
        self.place_at_grid(label_2d, "A1", scale_factor=1.0)
        
        # 3D case: Projected Cube with inscribed sphere
        cube_3d = VGroup(
            Square(side_length=1.4, color=BLUE_B),
            Square(side_length=1.4, color=BLUE_B).shift(0.3 * UR),
            Line(ORIGIN, 0.3 * UR).shift(0.7 * UL),
            Line(ORIGIN, 0.3 * UR).shift(0.7 * UR),
            Line(ORIGIN, 0.3 * UR).shift(0.7 * DL),
            Line(ORIGIN, 0.3 * UR).shift(0.7 * DR)
        )
        sphere_3d = Circle(radius=0.7, color=WHITE).shift(0.15 * UR)
        label_3d = Text("3D", font_size=20, color=BLUE_B)
        group_3d = VGroup(cube_3d, sphere_3d)
        
        self.place_in_area(group_3d, "A5", "B6", scale_factor=1.0)
        self.place_at_grid(label_3d, "A4", scale_factor=1.0)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(group_2d), FadeIn(label_2d))
        self.play(FadeIn(group_3d), FadeIn(label_3d))
        self.wait(2)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # Highlight corners in Magenta (#FF00FF)
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color(WHITE), self.lecture[1].animate.set_color("#FF00FF"))
        
        corner_points = [
            cube_3d[1].get_corner(UR),
            cube_3d[1].get_corner(UL),
            cube_3d[1].get_corner(DR),
            cube_3d[1].get_corner(DL)
        ]
        # Small highlights for corners
        corners_hl = VGroup(*[Dot(p, color="#FF00FF", radius=0.08) for p in corner_points])
        
        # Replacement for missing asset robot_packer icon
        robot_packer = Text("Robot Packer", font_size=24, color=WHITE)
        self.place_at_grid(robot_packer, "C1", scale_factor=0.6)
        
        # Filling corners with small spheres to represent "pockets"
        pockets = VGroup(*[Circle(radius=0.12, color="#FF00FF", fill_opacity=0.4, stroke_width=1).move_to(p) for p in corner_points])
        
        self.play(FadeIn(corners_hl), FadeIn(robot_packer))
        self.play(Create(pockets))
        self.wait(2)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # Sphere becomes a tiny dot relative to the volume
        self.play(self.lecture[1].animate.set_color(WHITE), self.lecture[2].animate.set_color(YELLOW))
        
        # Clear previous visualizations to focus on the high-D concept
        self.play(
            FadeOut(group_2d), FadeOut(label_2d), 
            FadeOut(group_3d), FadeOut(label_3d), 
            FadeOut(corners_hl), FadeOut(pockets),
            FadeOut(robot_packer)
        )
        
        # High-D Representation
        # Start with a standard size and scale up/down to show divergence
        hd_cube = Square(side_length=1.4, color=BLUE_E)
        hd_sphere = Circle(radius=0.7, color=WHITE, fill_opacity=0.3)
        hd_group = VGroup(hd_cube, hd_sphere)
        self.place_in_area(hd_group, "D2", "F5", scale_factor=1.0)
        
        hd_label = Text("High Dimensions (n=100)", font_size=20, color=BLUE_E)
        self.place_at_grid(hd_label, "D1", scale_factor=1.0)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(hd_group), FadeIn(hd_label))
        self.wait(1)
        
        # The stretching and shrinking
        island_text = Text("The Tiny Island", font_size=24, color=YELLOW)
        self.place_at_grid(island_text, "F3", scale_factor=0.8)
        
        self.play(
            hd_cube.animate.scale(2.5).set_stroke(width=1),
            hd_sphere.animate.scale(0.05).set_opacity(1.0),
            FadeIn(island_text),
            run_time=3
        )
        
        self.wait(3)
        self.play(self.lecture[2].animate.set_color(WHITE))
